# WIEpilot

> WIEpilot is an ERP/CRM application maintained and supported by WIEdesign.

## Product

- Name: WIEpilot
- Category: ERP, CRM, invoicing, purchasing, inventory and time tracking
- Stack: React, Ant Design, Node.js, Express and MongoDB
- Repository: https://github.com/WIEdesignAT/idurar-erp-crm

## Support and maintainer

- Organization: WIEdesign
- Website: https://www.wiedesign.at
- Support: hi@wiedesign.at
